events.title: Guy Fawkes Is Executed
events.description: Guy Fawkes was executed in London for his part in the Gunpowder Plot. The plot aimed to blow up the House of Lords and kill King James I.
events.significance: The failed plot is still remembered in Britain each November with Bonfire Night, and it hardened anti-Catholic sentiment in England for generations.

events.title: Franz Schubert Is Born
events.description: The Austrian composer Franz Schubert was born in Vienna. He wrote more than 600 songs, along with symphonies, chamber works and piano music, before dying aged 31.
events.significance: Schubert helped shape the Romantic era and made the German art song a major musical form.

events.title: Congress Passes the Thirteenth Amendment
events.description: In the last months of the Civil War, the U.S. Congress passed the Thirteenth Amendment and sent it to the states for ratification. It would abolish slavery throughout the United States.
events.significance: The amendment was ratified later that year and permanently ended legal slavery in the United States.

events.title: McDonald's Opens in Moscow
events.description: The first McDonald's in the Soviet Union opened in Moscow's Pushkin Square. Huge crowds queued for hours to get in.
events.significance: The opening became a lasting symbol of the thaw between East and West as the Cold War ended and the Soviet Union neared its collapse.
